sentences.text: Samsul @ Subhan vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023

Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 83
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 24893 of 2020
Applicant :- Samsul @ Subhan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar,Dinesh Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dewendra Singh
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
2. Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of applicant is taken on record.

3. Heard Sri Dinesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for applicant and Sri Dewendra Singh, learned counsel for the informant as well as Sri Ram Mohit Yadav, learned A.G.A. for the State.
4.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 92 of 2020, under Section 376 IPC, Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(5) SC/ST Act, Police Station Nichlaul,
District Maharajganj with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
5. As per prosecution story, the applicant is said to have sexually assaulted the daughter of the informant on 2.3.2020 at about 7 p.m. forcibly taking her to an orchard.

entities.text: Samsul @ Subhan vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The said allegations of rape are not substantiated by the statement of medical officer who is examined on oath as PW-5.
The statement has been filed with the supplementary affidavit today in Court, whereby learned counsel has stated that the victim as per ossification test report is 19 years of age.
Learned counsel has also stated that applicant has been falsely implicated in this case due to village political rivalry as Gram Pradhan belongs to adverse party.
Learned counsel has further stated that the Investigating Officer has not even corroborated the prosecution allegations and has stated that he did not find any allegations of offence of rape.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.

The applicant is in jail since 5.3.2020.
7.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant have vehemently opposed the bail application on the ground that as per school certificate which is on record the date of birth of victim is 16.8.2005 which renders her age to be about fourteen and half years at the time of offence.
Learned counsel has also stated that the statement of witnesses recorded in court reiterated the allegations leveled in the FIR and victim herself deposed on oath against the applicant.
The said fact is admitted by learned counsel for the applicant.

8. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, going through the evidence on record, considering the fact that already prosecution evidence is nearing at its conclusion and prosecution witnesses of fact have categorically deposed against the applicant and also taking into consideration the age of the victim as per school certificate and the case law settled by the Apex Court in Bharwada Bhoginbhai Hirjibhai vs. State of Gujarat, AIR 1983 SC 753, I do not find it a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.

entities.text: Bharwada Bhoginbhai Hirjibhai vs. State of Gujarat, AIR 1983 SC 753
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. The bail application is found devoid of merits and is, accordingly, rejected.

10. However, it is directed that the court below may proceed with the trial and reach at the logical conclusion expeditiously, if there is no legal impediment, within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.

11. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
